title: Reverse Subarray To Maximize Array Value
statement: Reverse exactly one subarray (or none) to maximize the sum of |nums[i] - nums[i+1]|; return the maximum final value.
constraints: The answer fits in a 32-bit integer
visualizationCap: nums capped at 50 values for the visualization; the solution is O(n)
notes: Brute-force checked against all subarray reversals on 3000 random arrays (length 2-7).
